caption: The drawing depicts a botanical motif with a central curving stem that branches outwards in multiple directions. Attached to the stem are various stylized flowers and leaves, rendered in a range of colors including shades of pink, red, yellow, green, blue, and brown. The flowers vary in shape, with some showing rounded petals and others more pointed or irregular contours. Some are fully colored, while others are outlined or partially filled in. Smaller buds and blossoms are interspersed among larger flowers. The stem is multicolored, with sections appearing in blue, yellow, and white. The background is a plain, pale or light beige color, and the botanical forms fill the central area of the drawing, leaving wide margins around the edges. The composition creates a sense of movement with its flowing, curved lines and scattered arrangement of blooms and leaves.
title: Bedspread (Detail)
